name: foldcn
install:
set -euo pipefail
# Prefer nvm Node 22.22.3 when present; otherwise the latest nvm v22 on this image.
if [ -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin" ]; then
  export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH"
else
  nvm_node_bin="$(ls -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/v22.*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n1 || true)"
  if [ -n "$nvm_node_bin" ]; then
    export PATH="$nvm_node_bin:$PATH"
  fi
fi
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
# pstack: home directory only, never the foldcn checkout
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cursor/plugins" "$HOME/.cursor/skills"
if [ ! -d "$HOME/.cache/cursor-plugins/.git" ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/cursor/plugins.git "$HOME/.cache/cursor-plugins"
fi
git -C "$HOME/.cache/cursor-plugins" fetch --depth 1 origin
git -C "$HOME/.cache/cursor-plugins" reset --hard origin/HEAD
git -C "$HOME/.cache/cursor-plugins" sparse-checkout set pstack
rm -rf "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/pstack"
cp -a "$HOME/.cache/cursor-plugins/pstack" "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/pstack"
shopt -s nullglob
for skill_dir in "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/pstack/skills"/*/; do
  ln -sfn "$skill_dir" "$HOME/.cursor/skills/$(basename "$skill_dir")"
done

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: pnpm --filter @foldcn/web run predev && pnpm --filter @foldcn/web exec vite --port 5173 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1
terminals.description: foldcn showcase site on a fixed port (5173). Cursor Desktop auto-forwards this port to your machine at http://localhost:5173 (use the plug icon in the Agents window). The predev step re-resolves styles and regenerates the style shims first. Use `pnpm dev:local` in the repo for portless .localhost URLs; this terminal runs plain Vite instead.
